---
title: "License"
---

**ADCP 1.1:** see the license file in the
[GitHub repository](https://github.com/ccsb-scripps/ADCP).

**ADFRsuite 1.0 (includes ADCP 1.0):** the suite contains several programs and components.
Unless otherwise specified, they are provided under the LGPL2 open-source license.

The one exception is the **MSMS** program and the **MSLIB** component, which compute molecular
surfaces. They are free for academic research but need a license for commercial use. Of the
suite's programs, only `agfrgui` uses them, for surface calculation and display. They are not
used by `adfr`, `agfr`, `autosite`, `adcp`, `prepare_ligand` or `prepare_receptor`.

For a commercial license for MSMS and MSLIB, contact [Dr. Michel Sanner](mailto:sanner@scripps.edu).
